    Diamond: σ = γ η generates the radical of End x #

    Given the generator ρ = ω' α at y and some generator π at x, σ = γ η is a generator at x (genσ): π begins with γ or δ (X1); δ is excluded by nL'; if σ = π^m with m ≥ 2, then η has at least three arrows, excluded by s_le_two (the case a = x is excluded by X1 applied to α).

    False

    An irreducible loop at y is impossible.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.DiamondData.three_arrows {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Infinite k] (D : DiamondData P) (hM : MildHyp k P) (μ ν : D.a ⟶ D.x) (hμ : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso μ) (hν0 : ν ≠ 0) (hν : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso ν) (hη : D.η = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp μ (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp D.γ ν)) :
    False

    A morphism with at least three arrows written as μ ≫ γ ≫ ν with μ, ν not invertible gives the shape of s_le_two.
